metrics.note: Timing only (seed-0 split, real data, RTX 3050); no accuracy claims.

projection_hours.assumptions: epoch = measured train + val pass; local-only = EPOCHS pooled epochs + 9 client test/held-out scorings (held-out scored by each client model, an over-estimate); no sleep / crash time

config.checkpoint_retention: resume checkpoints deleted once a run completes; best_model.pt kept
config.model: SiameseDamageNet(stage-1 UNetResNet body shared pre/post, 1x1 head on 64 ch)
config.loss: class-weighted cross-entropy on scored building pixels (background, un-classified ignored)

protocol.optimizer: AdamW(lr = lr-sweep choice, betas = (0.9, 0.999), eps = 1e-8, weight_decay = 1e-4) with an AMP GradScaler; identical for centralized, local-only and every FedAvg client
protocol.optimizer_state_centralized_and_local_on: kept across epochs (one continuous run per model)
protocol.optimizer_state_fedavg: reset every round: each client builds a fresh AdamW (and AMP GradScaler) from the broadcast global weights at the start of every round; Adam moment estimates are client-local, never communicated and never carried across rounds (they would describe a model the client no longer has)
protocol.batchnorm_aggregation_fedavg: BatchNorm running_mean / running_var are float buffers and are averaged with the same sample-size weights as the parameters (the global model is evaluated with these averaged statistics); num_batches_tracked (int64) is not averaged: the maximum across clients is kept, still int64. It is unused because every BatchNorm layer has momentum set (asserted). Note: averaging running_var ignores between-client differences in the means; FedBN (client-local BN) is a possible alternative, not used here.
protocol.init: each method from its own stage-1 weights (see module docstring); new head seeded with the run seed

class_weights.rule: models.class_weights_from_counts on damage-pixel counts of the training split (Silo 1 rule), capped at 10
class_weights.fedavg_and_fedavg_ft: federated sum of client 4-bin pixel histograms

protocol.fedavg_ft_optimizer: fresh AdamW per client, lr = sweep lr; loss weights = federated weights
